title: I did (not) ... Did you ...?
text: It was not easy, but he tried his best.
He had a sick old ox.
Meng Xin got back his sick old ox.
Meng Xin did not want to sell a sick old ox to others.
Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Long ago, there was a boy. His family _______ (have) some sheep.

The boy watched the sheep at the hill every day. He _______ (do not) like it. One day, he shouted, "Wolf! Wolf!" Some people _______ (come). They asked the boy, "_______ (do) you _______ (shout) for help?" "Yes, I _______ (do). Ha ha!" the boy answered.
sentences: It was not easy, but he tried his best.

Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
